race.comment: DSCHINGIS PRESTIGE (2) has got to a grade not many others in this race have been to and while he might be past his best, he could be ready to show something after three runs back. The low draw certainly helps his cause. CROSSOVERKID (8) has only won 1 of 21 starts and that was a tick over two years ago, but he's placed nine times, often in much better races than this. Ready for this trip now. INITIAL MOMENT (12) is usually thereabouts but finds it hard to win, with just two wins from 20 starts, but is back in class here and gets the inside alley. SMOKIN' ROHIE (3) was well-held last start over two miles, but won when dropping back in trip a couple of starts back, which is the same scenario here.
